channel.title: Los Angeles News Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles News Group (losangelesnewsgroup.com)

item.title: Pasadena Unified board to discuss ‘desired outcomes’ for key consolidation panel
item.description: With school consolidation a major focus of the district, the Pasadena Unified Board of Education will discuss key goals for a forthcoming advisory committee.

item.title: Matt Mahan is tougher on government unions than Chad Bianco
item.description: It's something to keep in mind ahead of the June primary.

item.title: Alijah Arenas has another big game, but USC loses to Ohio State
item.description: Arenas (25 points) makes a 3-pointer with 1:09 remaining to pull the Trojans within one, but Bruce Thornton and the Buckeyes hold on for an 89-82 win in a game between teams trying to improve their NCAA Tournament resumes.

item.title: Lauren Betts, No. 2 UCLA overpower No. 13 Michigan State
item.description: Betts has 22 points, seven rebounds and five assists, Kiki Rice finishes with 18 points, seven rebounds and five assists, and the Bruins extend their winning streak to 18 games with an 86-63 road win.

item.title: Kyle Busch, 0 for 20 all time in Daytona 500, captures pole
item.description: The two-time series champ, who brings a 93-race overall losing streak into the weekend, tops qualifying in his Richard Childress Racing Chevrolet and gets another shot at the elusive win. Chase Briscoe qualifies second in a Joe Gibbs Racing Toyota.

item.title: Real estate broker, 3 others accused in fraudulent sale of $1.5 million home in Burbank
item.description: The suspects are from Highland and LA County

item.title: Kawhi Leonard’s late heroics help Clippers edge Rockets
item.description: Leonard scores 19 of his 27 points in the fourth quarter, and his three-point play on a fadeaway jumper with two seconds left lifts the Clippers to a 105-102 road win in their final game before the All-Star break.

item.title: Fairfax boys basketball upsets No. 1 seed Birmingham in City playoffs
item.description: Chris Stokes scores 23 points to lead Fairfax to a victory that sets up a showdown with Cleveland in the Open Division semifinals.

item.title: Sierra Canyon boys basketball pulls away from Crespi with late surge
item.description: Maxi Adams and Brandon McCoy lead the Trailblazers' 17-0 run to secure the win in the opening game in the CIF-SS Open Division playoffs.

item.title: Millikan basketball blows out Thousand Oaks to begin Division 1 playoffs
item.description: Millikan uses a strong defensive effort to dominate Thousand Oaks and advance in the Division 1 playoffs.
